newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bonds underperform, supply beckons.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds underperform, supply beckons.

text.p: Australian bonds generally underperformed its dollar bloc partners as the local market made space for fresh supply.

The market got off on a soft footing after Friday's weak close in U.S. Treasuries, and eased from there as Queensland Treasury Corp (QTC) tendered A$100 million of stock and the Australian Treasury announced it would offer a total of A$600 million of bonds on Tuesday.

The most notable spread widening was against Canada, which continued to benefit from Thursday's Bank of Canada monetary policy report which said that inflation there was in danger of falling below its 1.0-3.0 target range.
The local yield curve also steepened, reversing some of the recent flattening trend, with all the new supply aimed at the long end of the curve.
